ns2:section.sectionText: Taught by Daniel Leon: History as Literature: This course will introduce the origins and early forms of western historical writing. We will begin with the first two Greek historians whose work has survived to us, Herodotus and Thucydides, setting their work in the context of their time before tracing their influence through antiquity and into the modern world. Along the way we will have occasion to explore how historical narratives can shape and inform political beliefs and social interactions. Techniques of literary analysis will be introduced to facilitate sophisticated readings of historical literature and allow for an examination of the goals and methods of historical authors.
